function: math:sin, math:cos, math:tan, math:asin, math:acos, math:atan, math:atan2
adaptations: hand-written case (happy + edge) — no upstream libxslt coverage exists for the trigonometric wrappers. Canonical angles pinned exactly where IEEE-exact (sin(0)=0, cos(0)=1, sin(pi/2)=1, cos(pi)=-1, acos(1)=0); tan(pi/4) and the inverse-function pins carry engine double noise (e.g. tan(pi/4)=0.9999999999999999). atan2(0,0) pins 0, which is the XPath 3.1/IEEE-754 defined result (not NaN). Domain edges: asin(2) pins NaN. Goldens are engine-verified output of src/math.xsl.
